text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut 232 mm off 63 x 3 mm PVC pressure pipe with a fine saw in a

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: mitre box; square the ends by sanding on a flat board.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Chamfer the inside of both ends 1 mm x 30 degrees so the O-rings

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: slide in without cutting. Deburr inside and out.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Six 4.5 mm screw holes, 4 mm from each end: three at each end,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 120 degrees apart. Mark them with a paper wrap round the tube.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drill the holes with the plug fitted, so the plug can be drilled

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 3.3 mm and tapped M4 through the same holes (see the plugs).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: plug spigots slide in until the flanges sit on the tube ends;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: both O-rings on each plug are inside, beyond the screws.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the ends are square; no scratches along the bore

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: in the 25 mm at each end where the O-rings seal.
